values: Free Customer Order Form Template: Excel + Printable PDF
Blank is for your work. Filled example is fictional. Keep the original file.
Yellow cells are editable; gray cells calculate. Do not overwrite formulas.
Ten rows per form. Extra rows need formula and total-range checks; use another version instead.
Nonnegative numbers, at most two decimals. Quantity accepts three decimals. Invalid or partial rows block final amounts.
One currency code labels all amounts; no conversion. Browser JSON backups do not import into this workbook.
Save as a new .xlsx, reopen it, change one amount, and verify the total before operational use.
Select A1:H33 on the required form tab. Choose landscape, Print Selection, and fit one page. Check all text in print preview.
Built and round-trip tested with Artifact Tool. Native Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets have not been certified. Keep original formulas when converting.
Complete header and manual review fields yourself. Draft totals and typed status do not authorize a transaction.

Two T-shirts at $25 each plus one $20 cap produce $70 in items. Add $8 shipping, $0 entered tax and $0 discount: the order total is $78. Record $30 paid to date with its payment reference: $48 remains. All names and amounts are fictional.
Enter a unique order reference, fixed date, seller and customer label. Use the notes for contact or delivery details only when needed, and store the saved copy appropriately.
Use SKU, item and size/color or unit to avoid variant confusion. Check availability separately before promising a delivery date.
Enter positive quantities and nonnegative unit prices. Enter shipping, tax and discount as amounts. The worksheet does not calculate jurisdiction-specific tax or convert currencies.
Enter only the cumulative amount actually paid and keep a payment reference. A requested deposit is not a received payment. For two payments, add them once to the cumulative paid amount.
Record the manual status and review date, agree any changes with the customer, then save a version. Use a packing slip for what is shipped and an invoice for an amount requested.

The browser form is a local worksheet. Saving or printing does not submit it to your customer or your shop. Review the details, then share the reviewed file through your own process. It has no checkout, inventory reservation or order inbox.
